name: strict
_what_this_is: A second customer, same code. This lender will not accept a tick or a single stroke as a selection and wants a person to look at it, and wants a scribbled-out box surfaced rather than quietly read as empty. They also want a wider band of uncertainty, because their file costs more to get wrong than to review.
_how_to_use: HV_POLICY=policy-strict.json uv run python evaluate.py, or HV_POLICY=policy-strict.json make serve. Nothing in src/ changes.
_what_changed: Three rulings and the width of the ambiguous band. Every other number is identical to policy.json.
